content.what_it_is: MATLAB postprocessing script for the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel_flat_bottom simple case (ship-wake wavemaker over a flat bottom): plots two surface-elevation snapshots as stacked pcolor panels. It loads eta_00001 from output/ to size the grid [n,m] (L4, L6), builds x,y with dx=dy=1.0 (L7-L10), selects snapshots nfile=[20 40] with time labels min={'20' '40'} (L12-L13), and sets an 8x5-inch figure (L15-L18). Per snapshot (L21-L40): loads eta_<fnum> (L23-L24), plots pcolor(x,y,eta) with flat shading in subplot(length(nfile),1,num) (L26-L28), fixes caxis [-1.5 1.5] (L30), titles ' Time = <min> sec ' (L31), labels y (m)/x (m) (L33, L35), and forces the zbuffer renderer (L38). A stale commented jpeg export remains at L41.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
eta — surface elevation, sizing load then per snapshot (L4, L24)
min — cell array of time labels {'20' '40'} (L13)

io.name: stacked pcolor panels of eta at 20 s and 40 s

unresolved: The variable name min (L13) shadows MATLAB's builtin min function within this workspace.
Labels '20'/'40' sec for snapshots 20/40 imply a 1 s output interval; must match the case input, not verifiable here.
No mask is applied (unlike sibling scripts), assuming a fully wet flat-bottom domain; consistency with the actual case is not checked in the file.
